verses.text: Once again, Israel did what Yahweh said was wrong, so Yahweh handed them over to the Philistines for forty years. 😔
A man named Manoah lived in Zorah, from the tribe of Dan. His wife couldn’t have children; she was unable to conceive. 🌿
Yahweh’s angel appeared to the woman and told her, ‘You can’t have children right now, but you will become pregnant and have a son. 👼
‘So be careful: don’t drink wine or strong drink, and don’t eat anything unclean. 🚫
‘You will become pregnant and have a son. No razor may touch his head, because he’ll be dedicated to God as a Nazirite from birth. He’ll begin rescuing Israel from the Philistines.’ ✨
The woman went and told her husband: ‘A man of God came to me. He looked awe-inspiring, like God’s angel. I didn’t ask where he was from, and he didn’t tell me his name. 🗣️

‘He told me, “You’ll become pregnant and have a son. Don’t drink wine or strong drink, and don’t eat anything unclean. The boy will be dedicated to God as a Nazirite from birth until the day he dies.”’ 📜
Manoah prayed to Yahweh: ‘Please, Lord, let the man of God you sent come back and teach us how to raise the child who’ll be born.’ 🙏
God heard Manoah. God’s angel came back to the woman while she was sitting out in the field—but Manoah wasn’t with her. 🌾
She hurried off and told her husband, ‘That man who came to me the other day is back!’ 🏃
Manoah got up, followed his wife, and came to the man. He asked, ‘Are you the one who spoke with my wife?’ ‘I am,’ he answered. 👀
Manoah said, ‘Let everything you said happen. What will the boy’s life and mission look like?’ ❓
Yahweh’s angel told Manoah, ‘Your wife must follow everything I already told her. 📣
‘She must not eat anything from the grapevine, drink wine or strong drink, or eat anything unclean. She must follow every instruction I gave her.’ 🍇
Manoah said to Yahweh’s angel, ‘Please stay while we prepare a young goat for you.’ 🐐
Yahweh’s angel replied, ‘Even if I stay, I won’t eat your food. If you prepare a burnt offering, offer it to Yahweh.’ Manoah didn’t realize he was Yahweh’s angel. 🔥
Manoah asked Yahweh’s angel, ‘What’s your name? We want to honor you when your words come true.’ 🗣️
Yahweh’s angel said, ‘Why ask my name? It’s beyond understanding.’ ✨
Manoah took the young goat and grain offering and offered them on a rock to Yahweh. Then the angel did something amazing while Manoah and his wife watched. 🐐
As flames rose from the altar toward the sky, Yahweh’s angel went up in the altar’s flame. Manoah and his wife watched, then fell face-down on the ground. 🔥
Yahweh’s angel never appeared to Manoah or his wife again. Then Manoah realized he had seen Yahweh’s angel. 👼
Manoah said to his wife, ‘We’re definitely going to die—we’ve seen God!’ 😨
But his wife said, ‘If Yahweh wanted to kill us, he wouldn’t have accepted our burnt and grain offerings, shown us all this, or told us these things right now.’ 🕊️
The woman had a son and named him Samson. The child grew, and Yahweh blessed him. 👶
Yahweh’s Spirit began stirring Samson at Mahaneh-Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol. 🕊️
